_comment: Cases for the inline-script string detector (scripts/lib/jsscan.js). 'flag' texts must be reported as human-readable copy, 'ignore' texts must not. Sentences deliberately contain { } ; = < > and backticks: the detector judges what a string says, never which characters it contains.

cases.name: sentence with braces, semicolon, equals and angle brackets
template literal with backticks and an expression
cases.code: el.textContent = `Thanks, ${name}! We will be in touch.`;

cases.name: HTML held in a string: text and readable attributes
cases.code:
box.innerHTML = '

Hello there friend

';

cases.name: ternary message
cases.code: el.textContent = ok ? "All sent, thank you!" : "Something went wrong.";

cases.name: second argument of setAttribute is copy, the first is not
object values: copy is flagged, API vocabulary is not
cases.code: var COPY = { title: "Hello there friend", method: "POST", type: "button", mode: "cors" };

cases.name: selectors, classes, events, media queries, css values and directives are code
cases.code: "use strict"; document.querySelector(".hero h1"); el.classList.add("is-open", "btn btn-primary"); window.matchMedia("(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)"); el.addEventListener("click", f); el.style.transition = "opacity 1s ease"; el.className = "visually-hidden sr-state"; if (typeof x === "undefined") {} if (node.tagName === "BR") {} if ("IntersectionObserver" in window) {}

cases.name: network and developer-facing strings are not site copy
cases.code: fetch("/", { method: "POST", headers: { "Content-Type": "application/x-www-form-urlencoded" } }); throw new Error("HTTP " + r.status); console.log("debug message here"); new URL("/path", base);

cases.name: urls, numbers, colours, dates, file names
cases.code: a = "https://example.com/x"; b = "12px"; c = "#ffcc00"; d = "2026-06-28"; e = "hero-poster.jpg"; f = "en-GB"; g = "mailto:"; var re = /a b c/;

cases.name: code that looks like a sentence is still reported (move it or allow-list it with a reason)
cases.code: el.textContent = "if (a < b && c > d) { go(); } else { stop = 1; }";
flag: if (a < b && c > d) { go(); } else { stop = 1; }
